long_biography.plain_text:
Before the family entered public business life, Mukadaskhan Ibragimova trained as a nurse. She concentrated on raising four closely aged sons after the family's move to Almaty. Her son Shukhrat recalls that she devoted herself to their upbringing while Alijan Ibragimov built the enterprises that later formed the family's holdings.

From July 2021, Eurasian Financial Company listed Ibragimova as a 33.3 per cent shareholder. Kazakhstan's financial regulator approved her as a major indirect participant in Eurasia Insurance the following year. In February 2026, she transferred 30 per cent of the financial holding to Shukhrat, retaining 3 per cent. Shukhrat also chairs ERG and serves as its chief executive, representing the family's interest in the group.

uncertainties.detail: The exact source name is strongly resolved to Mukadaskhan Nasirzhanovna Ibragimova. A French filing uses Mukadaskhan Yousoupov for Alijan Ibragimov's wife; the shared given name, spouse, succession and four sons establish the alias match, but the dossier does not propose Yousoupov as a middle or current surname.

Forbes Kazakhstan maintains a current Ibragimov-family ranking page and published a 2026 richest-women entry for Mukadaskhan Ibragimova. Neither is a dedicated exact-person profile, so the Forbes social field remains unproposed.

Current Forbes Kazakhstan reporting places 20.7 per cent of ERG with Ibragimova and her four sons collectively, without disclosing their individual allocations. It reports that her personal Eurasian Financial Company stake fell from 33 per cent to 3 per cent in February 2026.

No executive or board position for Ibragimova was established. Current reporting identifies Shukhrat as the family's ERG representative and executive, so Heir / family shareholder is used rather than Operator.
The nursing training and family role come from a direct interview with her son Shukhrat. No sufficiently detailed independent account of her education, birthplace or employment history was found.

The source owner record lists the United Kingdom as main residence, while a 2022 French company filing gave a Swiss residence. No sufficiently current independent source resolves the discrepancy, so no residence correction or secondary-residence proposal is made.

The Kazakhstanian nationality and Kazakhstan birth-country fields are preserved from the source record but were not independently established to proposal confidence. No second nationality or precise birthplace was verified.

Focused exact-name searches found no identity-verified personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, TikTok or personal website. Family, company, fan and namesake pages are not substituted.

The source record associates Ibragimova with I Dynasty, while public material associates the vessel with Alijan Ibragimov and the wider family. This was used only to disambiguate the owner record; no vessel fact appears in either biography or any wealth classification.
The biographies are limited to her independently supported family, inheritance and shareholder record. They do not attribute Alijan's operating achievements or Shukhrat's executive work to her.
